w: This evening, Swamishri arrived for the 'National Youth Convention' of satsangi youths. Four hundred and seventy youths (yuvak-yuvati) had arrived for the convention. The convention theme was - Satsang our Family. Swamishri lighted the inaugural lamp and elaborated on the aims of the Convention.

At 11.45 am, Swamishri arrived back to Amdavad. In the evening, due to fatigue and heat of the previous day, Swamishri caught a fever. For the next four to five days Swamishri took rest and medication.
In the happiness of others lies our own. In the good of others lies our own. In the services of others lies our own.

If you look after your money then it will take care of you. If you look after your house then it will take care of you. If you take care of animals then they will take care of you. By taking care of things they will in return take care of you.
God's name is like amrut. It redeems, therefore one should chant His name with glory.

By attending the Sunday Satsang assembly one experiences peace. Because of this all one's work related to family, mundane affairs, society, nation and redemption are attained in this birth. And subsequently one does not have to be reborn again.
In the morning Swamishri visited the festival site and inspected in detail the preparations of the kitchen, accommodation, stage and other departments.

Swamishri blessed Paresh Parekh who walked 475 km from Belgium to London. He did this to celebrate the BAPS Centenary Year and please Swamishri. As he travelled he was warmly supported and honoured along the way by mayors of cities and schoolchildren walked with him in solidarity for three kilometres. In the evening assembly a grand drama presentation about the history of Bochasan village was performed by a cast of 200 children, teenagers, youths and devotees. Adarshjivan Swami had written the script and it was directed by Manoharmurti Swami and Yagnatilak Swami. After the first part Swamishri blessed the assembly explaining how Shriji Maharaj came to Bochasan as Nilkanth Varni and subsequently as Maharaj to fulfil the devotion of Kashidas Mota. Part two was performed the next day (29/9). On 30/9 a national shibir was organized for the entire day for the main volunteers of UK.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

Two sadhus of Chicago observed liquid fasts for 100 hours. All fourteen sadhus of London mandir observed fasts for nearly four days to please Swamishri. In all, 241 devotees observed different austerities, out of which 160 women and 80 men observed liquid fasts for 100 hours, 15 youths observed waterless fasts, 8 men and 7 women observed waterless fast for 100 hrs. Jignesh Valand observed Bhagatji vrat and a waterless fast for 100 hrs. Tilak Dilip Patel observed waterless fasts and Viren Mistri and Vishal observed taptakrucch vrat.
Paresh Parekh pilgrimaged 475 km by foot from Belgium to London.

ds.t: What Pramukh Swami Maharaj wished for
w: Today Pramukh Swami Maharaj taught a young man a lesson in humility: "When we come before Thakorji, we should do dandvat. Remember this. When we meet sadhus, we should bow down and do panchang pranam, and greet devotees with folded hands and 'Jay Swaminarayan'. This is our good manners. It is God's command. We may stand tall everywhere else, but here we must stay humble." Swamishri taught the lesson of good manners. Lately Swamishri has been stressing this especially. In America, Swamishri had seen this kind of courtesy in every child and teenager, because there every child, teen and youth would do panchang pranam to every sadhu they met and say 'Jay Swaminarayan'. Seeing this, Swamishri expressed his wish that the same custom be followed everywhere. And so the practice began here too.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of the marble murtis of Ghanshyam Maharaj, Guru-Parampara and Nilkanth Varni (metal) for the BAPS hari mandir in Kampala. Swamishri also performed abhishek of Nilkanth Varni.

25 September 2010, Sarangpur An aspirant enquired, “How can I get rid of negative thoughts?” Swamishri replied in two words, “Do bhajan.”Remembering God is the panacea of all ills. To console the mind of anxiety and frustration Swamishri advised with surety.
